_readme: Freshness badges, connectivity states, and the widget/complication strings.
The ALL-CAPS keys are rendered through .textCase(.uppercase) rather than uppercased() so Turkish
dotted i survives; the translations here are written in caps anyway for the locales that have
case, because the source string is the lookup key and must read naturally if the style is dropped.
'VS' is deliberately absent: it is a borrowed abbreviation used as-is in every shipped locale.
